pull-request-header:
MedTracker 0.6 prioritises lower operating RAM and hosting on modest hardware. Rails remains an excellent framework. In a single local seeded DM+d comparison on 23 October 2026, application-container working set five minutes after import was about 908 MiB for threaded Rails and 205 MiB for Loco background import; supporting services are excluded. These are measurements of the tested implementations, not hardware-sizing or language-wide guarantees.

See the [0.6 release overview](https://github.com/damacus/med-tracker/blob/main/docs/releases/0.6.md) for delivered improvements and development trade-offs, and the [memory comparison](https://github.com/damacus/med-tracker/blob/main/docs/development/runtime-benchmark-2026-10-23.md) for all modes, whole-stack figures and limitations.
